senses.zh_definition: 若此处指日语 tantō，则为日本传统短刀；输入缺乏上下文，不能确认这就是该词例的实际含义。
senses.en_definition: If representing Japanese tantō, a traditional Japanese dagger or short sword; the intended meaning of this input remains unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada istilah Jepun tantō, sejenis pisau atau pedang pendek tradisional Jepun; maksud sebenar bentuk dalam input ini belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 这是有条件的外语释义，不是已核实的马来语正式词条。以下例句仅示范日本短刀这一解释；搭配为说明性组合，未经语料频率验证。博物馆确实使用 Tanto 指日本短刀。[京都国立博物馆藏品资料](https://knmdb.kyohaku.go.jp/eng/4215.html)

etymology.historical_story: One possible identification is Japanese tantō, written 短刀, literally 'short blade'. Japanese museum catalogues use the term for historical daggers and short swords. That documented Japanese word does not establish the language or meaning of an isolated corpus token spelled tanto. Without its original sentence, assigning a Malay origin, a single pronunciation, or an official Malay status would be speculative. [Japanese cultural heritage catalogue](https://jpsearch.go.jp/en/item/cobas-168109)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 仅在确认为日语 tantō 时，把它与汉字“短刀”配对记忆；来源未明时不要先固定读音或释义。
